name: Functions and Graphs
description: Read a function as a machine and its graph as a picture, then build new functions from old ones.

requires.why: Writes function rules as algebraic expressions and evaluates them in function notation.
Reads domains and ranges written as inequalities, with filled and hollow ends on a number line.
Solves linear equations to find line intercepts and the line through two points.

levels.name: Curves and what they tell you

requires.why: Rearranges a formula to find an inverse function and solves inequalities for piecewise payoffs.
Turns percentage rises and falls into multipliers, as in 5% up then 5% down, for log-price moves.

lessonNames.l1-machines: Machines that turn inputs into outputs
lessonNames.l2-table-to-rule: From a table to a rule
lessonNames.l3-what-goes-in: What goes in and what can come out
lessonNames.l11-reading-a-graph: Reading a graph like a chart

lessonObjectives.l1-machines: Evaluate a function for a given input and write its rule in function notation.
lessonObjectives.l2-table-to-rule: Find the rule of a function from a table of its values.
lessonObjectives.l3-what-goes-in: State the domain and range of a simple function.
lessonObjectives.l4-one-output: Decide whether a rule or a graph describes a function.
lessonObjectives.l5-plotting: Plot coordinates and draw a line from a table of values.
lessonObjectives.l6-how-steep: Measure the gradient of a line as rise over run between two points.
lessonObjectives.l7-slope-and-start: Read and write a line as $y = mx + c$ and say what $m$ and $c$ mean.
lessonObjectives.l8-line-through-two-points: Find the equation of the line through two given points.
lessonObjectives.l9-parallel-perpendicular: Use gradients to test whether two lines are parallel or perpendicular.
lessonObjectives.l10-curves-from-tables: Plot quadratic, cubic and reciprocal functions from tables and describe their shapes.
lessonObjectives.l11-reading-a-graph: Read roots, intercepts and turning points from a graph.
lessonObjectives.l12-graphs-that-tell-stories: Interpret distance-time and cost graphs, including what the gradient means.
lessonObjectives.l13-solving-with-graphs: Solve an equation by finding where two graphs meet.
lessonObjectives.l14-sliding: Predict how $f(x) + a$ and $f(x + a)$ move a graph.
lessonObjectives.l15-stretching: Predict how $af(x)$, $f(ax)$ and $-f(x)$ change a graph.
lessonObjectives.l16-machine-after-machine: Compose two functions and see that the order matters.
lessonObjectives.l17-running-backwards: Find an inverse function and see its graph as a reflection in $y = x$.
lessonObjectives.l18-payoff-is-a-function: Write a simple trading payoff as a piecewise function and draw its graph.
